definitions.diagnostics: Recorded after backward BEFORE optimizer.step at global12001,12501,13001,...; per-scale class target counts, target-class mean CE, soft Dice including background; separate body/head L2 gradient norms. Conditional CE means are NOT class-weighted objective terms.
definitions.fp: FP voxels=predicted lesion minus TP. Saved predicted component count is NOT FP-component count on positive cases; one predicted component may touch multiple reference components. Empty-case predicted components are all false positives.
definitions.gradient: Unclipped pre-update aggregate L2 over parameters; body excludes seg_outputs.*, heads includes them. All parameter gradients checked finite every update by producer; individual gradient tensors not saved.
definitions.loss: Five scales [16,8,4,2,1]/31. Each: voxel-mean CE + 1 - mean soft Dice over foreground classes pancreas/lesion; absent classes included; smooth1e-5; nearest target interpolation.
definitions.metrics: Positive-case macro Dice excludes34empty references; lesion target overrides pancreas. Case hit=any overlapping lesion voxel. Components use26-connectivity; reference-component hit=any overlap; small=total lesion volume<1000mm3, medium<=10000mm3, large>10000mm3. These are case size bands, not individual lesion sizes.
definitions.normalization: Finite float32 CT clip[-100,250], shift+100/divide350; then logged geometric/intensity augmentation. No zscore. Saturation fractions not recorded.
